options.name: api_token
options.description: The api token for the truenas server.

options.name: comment
options.description: Add a comment in truenas to the nfs share.

options.name: hosts
options.description: A list of hosts which can access the nfs share.

options.name: mapall_group
options.description: The specified permissions of that group are used by all clients.

options.name: mapall_user
options.description: The specified permissions of that user are used by all clients.

options.name: maproot_group
options.description: When a group is selected, the root user is also limited to the permissions of that group.

options.name: maproot_user
options.description: When a user is selected, the root user is limited to the permissions of that user.

options.name: networks
options.description: A list of networks that can access the nfs share.

options.name: path
options.description: The path to share from the the truenas server.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether to create or update(present), or remove (absent) the nfs share.

options.name: url
options.description: The url of the truenas server.

options.name: verify
options.description: Whether to verify the ssl certificate or not
